ns2:section.sectionText: Most of this course will be very flexible in timing to accommodate students' schedules. There are two fixed times for the midterm and the final exam. The midterm exam is scheduled to be held on Friday, May 27, 2022 with the exam beginning at approximately 8am CDT (international students, or others who choose to do so, will be permitted to begin the exam as early as 6:30am CDT) and the final exam is scheduled to be held on Friday, June 10, 2022 with approximately the same start times as the midterm. All exams will be taken online using ProctorU. ProctorU is an online proctoring service that allows students to take exams remotely. Students will be responsible for the ProctorU exam charges (paid directly to ProctorU)~ cost is pending, but will follow the typical ProctorU pricing structure. This course will use Moodle.
